scope: Raise the default desktop calendar, analog clock, and timer stack by 48 logical pixels in both editions.
approval: The maintainer replied yes to releasing the placement after seeing the Golden Gate preview and the Tahoe candidate beside the Apple reference.

checks.command: Installed the approved Tahoe and Golden Gate candidates in disposable KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland overlays. On first placement the calendar, analog clock, and timer started at y=62, 286, and 510 logical pixels at x=48. The positions matched in light and dark mode.

Verified both installed placement SHA-256 records against the release source. Between the preview baseline and v0.82.9, runtime changes were scoped to the Dock and Apps button. The widget package, placement entry point, top panel, and desktop containment were unchanged.
Verified the Tahoe component fingerprint ledger and inspected the focused release diff with git diff --check.

coverage_limits: KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland at 2x scale with one display. The preview used the v0.82.8 baseline. This changes first placement for the starter set.
